steps.title: Open the embedded editor
steps.body: Wait for the Octodraw webcomponent to load. If the runtime bundle is not present in local development, the page should show a clear loading failure instead of crashing.

steps.title: Use orbit view
steps.body: Use right mouse drag to orbit the scene and the mouse wheel to zoom. Keep the Y-up workspace in mind.

steps.title: Prepare the rectangle tool
steps.body: Activate the rectangle tool from the toolbar or command palette. Draw a small rectangle on the ground plane.
